preview.sheetPoint1: Internal energy U is a state function: it depends only on initial and final states.
preview.sheetPoint2: Isochoric process (constant V): W = 0, therefore ΔU = Qv.
preview.sheetPoint3: Isolated system: no heat or work exchange (ΔU = 0).
preview.sheetChapterAction: Quiz or Memory cards for this chapter · 0.5 gen
preview.examStep1Text: Positive-term series: apply the Ratio Test on u(n+1) / u(n).
preview.examStep2Text: lim(n→∞) u(n+1)/u(n) = 1/3 < 1 — the series converges absolutely.
preview.examRapidAnswer: Direct answer: the series ∑ u(n) converges absolutely (Ratio Test limit = 1/3 < 1).
preview.examTip: Key takeaway: always justify term positivity before applying the Ratio Test.
preview.quizQuestion: Which condition is essential for a contract to be legally valid?
preview.quizOptB: Free and informed consent of the parties
preview.quizFeedbackCorrect: Spot on! Without free and informed consent (free from mistake, fraud, or duress), a contract can be voided.
preview.quizFeedbackWrong: Not quite — validity depends primarily on the free and informed consent of the parties.

preview.tutorHighlightedText: "Osmosis is the net movement of solvent molecules through a semi-permeable membrane toward a higher solute concentration."
preview.tutorReplyText: In plain terms: water always moves from the less salty side to the saltier side to balance both out — just like vegetables releasing water when you sprinkle salt on them.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before launching your first session on Sphera and Sphera Live.
faq.contactPrompt: Still have a question? Reach us at
faq.a1: Sphera is an AI study companion built by CampusSphere. From your lectures, it creates chapter summaries, exam paper solutions, practice quizzes, memory cards, audio lessons, and visual course maps — plus an unlimited AI tutor and Sphera Live.
faq.q2: What is Sphera Live and how does it work?
faq.a2: Sphera Live is our real-time group quiz mode. A host generates questions from a course or writes them manually, then opens a room. Players enter the 6-letter code on their phone to compete live with a synced timer and podium.
faq.q3: Do I need an account to use Sphera and Sphera Live?
faq.a3: Yes, an account saves your summaries, notes, study streak, and lets you join live games. If you already use CampusSphere, log in with 1 click (or with Google).
faq.a4: You can upload PDFs (even scanned handouts), Word files (.docx), text files, photos of notes or boards (PNG, JPG, WEBP), CampusSphere links, or simply paste your notes.
faq.q5: Can I download or share my study sessions?
faq.a5: Yes! You can share any session with a public link, download course summaries and exam solutions as PDF, save audio lessons as MP3, and export visual course maps as images.
faq.a6: During open beta, you get 10 free generations every week (automatically refilled every Monday): 1.0 gen for a full course tool, 0.5 gen for one chapter or highlighted passage, and 0 gen (100% free) for the AI tutor and your personal notes.
faq.a7: Yes. Your files are encrypted and stored securely solely to build your study materials. They are never sold or shared without your consent.
faq.q8: Does Sphera work for my major?
faq.a8: Yes! Sphera adapts to all majors (medicine, law, engineering, computer science, economics, management, humanities) and lets you pick the level of detail and teaching style you prefer.
